text: Predictions have systematic positive bias (overpredict severity) due to pipeline change shifting prediction level.
rationale: Sample rows show prediction > target in all 5 examples (e.g., 819 vs 614). Objective says systematically off since pipeline change, suggesting global intercept/scale shift.

text: Error is feature-dependent miscalibration (slope/scale error with amount or velocity), not uniform bias.
rationale: Severity often scales with amount/velocity; pipeline change could have broken feature scaling causing slope error rather than intercept shift.

text: Apparent systematic error is artifact of data quality issues (missing, duplicates, corrupt target/prediction values).
rationale: Pipeline changes often introduce missing/duplicated/corrupted rows that inflate error metrics without true model bias.
